sloka: अथ तस्मिन्निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।सुग्रीवं सम्परिष्वज्य तदा वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.४१.१ ।।।।
transliteration: atha tasminnimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।sugrīvaṁ sampariṣvajya tadā vacanamabravīt ।। 6.41.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama, brother of Lakshmana, seeing the signs of war, embraced Sugriva and spoke these words.
